Class CardCatalog

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.view.TUI.CardCatalog
public class CardCatalog extends Object
Card/tile lookup for the TUI. For every card id it stores the visual type (CardCatalog.ClassKind + era) plus the numbers a player needs to make decisions (Edificio cost/points, Sciamano stars) and a one-line, rulebook-flavoured effect description. It also exposes the action of each Offer tile and the food/points effect of each Order-of-Turn slot.

The five JSON resources under /json/ are read once at construction; failures (missing resource, malformed entry) are swallowed and the catalog returns neutral defaults (CardCatalog.ClassKind.UNKNOWN, -1, "").
